data.title: Smuggler’s Run Pass: Loot Up with 35+ Rewards!
data.summary: Run, don’t walk, to the new Battle Pass!
data.meta_title: Smuggler’s Run Pass: Loot Up with 35+ Rewards!
data.content:
A resourceful Pilot is a successful Pilot—start taking what you deserve today with the Smuggler’s Run Battle Pass!

The Battle Pass is your ticket to the hottest gear on the Wild Ten. Play to earn XP and Battle Tokens, level up your Pass, and exchange your Battle Tokens for new content.

Smuggler’s Run Battle Pass

The Smuggler’s Run Battle Pass can be found via the main menu. It features the new War Robot—Scorpion—and 35+ other valuable rewards, including Salvage, Credits, Premium Account, unique cosmetics, and battle gear!

Battle Passes are only available for a limited time during Seasons.New Shipments of rewards will become available while the Battle Pass is active. You need to complete the Battle Pass while it’s available to unlock everything it has to offer!

  • Battle Pass (Free): Progress without spending a penny! Battle Tokens can be earned through battles and used to level up your Pass. You won’t be able to unlock every reward from all Shipments unless you upgrade to Battle Pass Gold.
  • Battle Pass Gold (200 WarpReals): Upgrade to Battle Pass Gold to earn enough Battle Tokens to obtain every item from the Battle Pass.

Shipment 1 (Unlocks April 22)

  • Scorpion (War Robot):
    • 1x Torso Module
    • 1x Chassis Module
  • Wasteland Wrap
  • Robot Chopper Sticker
  • Mustard Paint
  • Dragonfruit Paint
  • Concrete Dust Wear & Tear
  • 3x Tusk Weapons
  • Credits 
  • Salvage 
  • Premium Account

Shipment 2 (Unlocks April 29)

Spend 110 Battle Tokens to unlock this Shipment.

  • Knight Steel Paint
  • Charcoal Paint
  • Warp Piercer Sticker
  • Chop Bot Sticker
  • 3x Tusk Weapons
  • Will Washington Common Pilot
  • Repulsor Supply Gear
  • Credits 
  • Salvage 
  • Premium Account

Shipment 3 (Unlocks May 6)

Spend 210 Battle Tokens to unlock this Shipment.

  • Scorpion (War Robot):
    • 2x Shoulder Module
    • 1x Chassis Module
  • 2x Tusk Weapons
  • Regal Silver Paint
  • Quagmire Paint
  • Repulsor Supply Gear
  • Gamma Beam Cycle Gear
  • Warp Gate Decal
  • Digital Devil Decal
  • Got’em Good Sticker
  • Helldive Sticker
  • Credits

Smuggler’s Run Twitch Drops (April 29)

Earn Twitch Drops from April 29 including Salvage, Credits, cosmetic items, and more! Stay tuned for more info.
